title: WoVoGen: World Volume-aware Diffusion for Controllable Multi-camera Driving Scene Generation
control_family: layout, box, map or BEV conditioning

output_modality.value: six-camera street-view images and videos, plus predicted future 4D world volume (HD map and occupancy)

control_signal.value: ego control sequence (velocity, steering) for future world volume; world volume for images; text prompts for weather, location, object classes; camera extrinsic and volume edits

control_mechanism.value: action tokens via cross-attention and past volumes by channel concatenation; world-volume image features as ControlNet input; CLIP text by cross-attention; object guidance by masked cross-attention

base_model.value: stage 1: latent diffusion UNet trained from scratch on world-volume latents (VQ autoencoder); stage 2: Stable Diffusion-based panoptic multi-camera diffusion with ControlNet and temporal attention

datasets.value: nuScenes (700 train, 150 val videos, six cameras) with Occ3D challenge occupancy and HD map; BEVDet-occ infers input world volumes

metrics.value: FID, FVD, Key Points Matching for consistency; BEVDet NDS and mAP for downstream detection

controllability_evidence.value: Ablation FID 28.6 object guidance only, 27.6 world volume plus object guidance; KPM 90.0% multi-view, 80.2% temporal; generated data lifts BEVDet vehicle mAP from 34.9 to 36.2.

closed_loop.value: No interactive policy rollout stated; future volumes are predicted from past volumes and ego controls.

notes: Two-stage design mixes action, volume and text control; family chosen for the dense world-volume condition. Single-frame FID 27.6 and video FVD 417.7. Packet lacks a limitations section.
